lost_after_30.why: guesses a month: a book more than 30 days late counts as lost, instead of more than 60

no_amnesty.why: has no amnesty day: a late book brought back on a Tuesday pays like any other

grace_under_4.why: off by one: a book exactly 4 days late pays, though up to 4 days late is free

free_thursdays.why: makes Thursday the amnesty day instead of Tuesday
